data.title: RGA Highlights Road Safety Gains, Develops Services on Intercity Roads
data.content:
Riyadh, November 26, 2026, SPA -- The Roads General Authority (RGA) continues to enhance the road user experience across Saudi Arabia through initiatives and projects that aim to improve safety and develop services on intercity roads.
    RGA said initiatives and projects carried out with members of the Ministerial Committee of Traffic Safety helped reduce Saudi Arabia’s road traffic fatality rate by about 60% between 2016 and 2025.
    RGA is also working with the National Center for Privatization & PPP and private sector partners to develop one-stop stations on intercity roads, bringing together fuel, shopping, rest areas, vehicle maintenance, and hospitality services at each site.
    -- SPA
